## About
Menlo Atherton Auto Repair is a family-owned and operated shop on El Camino Real in Menlo Park. We look after cars for folks in Redwood City, Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Atherton, Portola Valley and Mountain View.
The first time you visit, we enter the important details about your car into our computer system. That helps us plan future service more accurately and get you in and out faster. If you ever sell your car and need that history, we're happy to hand it over.
Our neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating on Google from 986 reviews. Give us a call or schedule an appointment, and we'll take it from there.

## Services
- Hybrid service and repair: Hybrids need special care, and our ASE certified mechanics work on models like the Toyota Prius, Toyota Camry Hybrid, Honda Civic Hybrid, Ford Fusion Hybrid, Chevy Volt and Nissan Leaf.
- Engine repair and replacement: From diagnosing an engine problem to replacing the engine when it's needed.
- Transmission service and repair: Routine transmission service and repairs when something isn't shifting right.
- Electrical system diagnosis and repair: Tracking down and fixing electrical problems.
- Shocks and struts: Suspension work to keep your ride steady and comfortable.
- Muffler service and repair: Exhaust and muffler repairs.
- Smog checks: One reviewer had a regular service and smog check done in a couple hours.

## FAQ
Q: Do you look over my car when I bring it in?
A: Yes. Every vehicle that comes in for service or repair gets a complimentary courtesy inspection. It accompanies any paid service and does not replace diagnostics.

Q: What happens after I drop off my car?
A: We'll call you first thing in the morning to work out a service plan with you.

Q: Which areas do you serve?
A: We serve Redwood City, Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Atherton, Portola Valley and Mountain View.

Q: What are your Saturday hours?
A: Saturday from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.
